name: @quereus/plugin-loader
description: Plugin loading system for Quereus - supports dynamic imports for Node.js and browsers

scripts.//typecheck: NOTE: the second pass type-checks test/ too (tsconfig.json only includes src/). vitest transpiles specs without checking them, so without this a signature change in src/ would leave the specs silently stale.
scripts.//test: NOTE: test/ covers url validation + the loader's protocol allowlist, npm-spec parsing, CDN url building, env detection, loadPlugin dispatch, config interpolation/validation, and the config channel. Known gaps (all need network or a DOM): https:// module loads, manifest fetch from a plugin's package.json, and the real browser+CDN load path. --passWithNoTests is deliberately NOT set, so a glob that stops matching fails loudly instead of reporting green.
